screening_isotropic.nu_provenance: Exact-brand Bambu-X1C in-plane flat measurement at 18 C; separate process from the TDS summary

source.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0

supplemental_in_plane_poisson_evidence.process_transfer_restriction: exact-brand process-conditioned value; used as a bounded room-temperature in-plane sensitivity, not a universal out-of-plane or environmental law

limitations: TDS values are summary means and standard deviations, not raw curves.
The TDS does not report Poisson ratios or shear moduli; nu12 comes from a separate exact-brand Bambu-X1C process.
Out-of-plane Poisson ratios and all directly measured quasistatic shear moduli remain unavailable.
No temperature-dependent constitutive curve is provided.
Strength references do not define a damage or fracture law.
intended_use: Transverse-isotropic elastic sensitivity using TDS XY/Z Young moduli, a separate exact-brand measured in-plane Poisson ratio, and explicitly marked remaining out-of-plane priors

engineering_constants_evidence.E1: TDS XY Young modulus; local 1 is bead direction
engineering_constants_evidence.E2: TDS XY Young modulus tied to E1; local 2 is in-layer transverse direction
engineering_constants_evidence.E3: TDS Z Young modulus; local 3 is build direction
engineering_constants_evidence.nu12: direct exact-brand in-plane flat measurement at 18 C / 40% RH from the checksum-pinned Bambu-X1C reference
engineering_constants_evidence.nu23: tied to nu13 by transverse-isotropic hypothesis
engineering_constants_evidence.G12: derived from E1 and nu12 by in-plane isotropy
engineering_constants_evidence.G23: tied to G13 by transverse-isotropic hypothesis
